summary: 2026 home kit (the calendar-year CSL season, filed as 2026-27 in this dataset). Front of shirt documented by named press: X1 Xi Wang (犀旺) sports drink and Tongshun Real Estate (统顺地产). The club's December 2025 sponsorship brochure offered two back-of-shirt slots and one sleeve-ad slot for the 2026 season; who holds those in 2026 was not confirmed from any source that could be opened, so the sponsor list is not complete. The team plays in 2026 as 大连英博海发 (Dalian Yingbo Haifa) under a naming-rights deal; naming rights are not a shirt placement.
